title: How to Choose the Right Size

standards.title: Manufacturer Standards
standards.description: The following hookless (TSS) and hooked (TC) rim inner width charts from DT Swiss show recommended and possible combinations. The HTML tables transcribe the chart rows for search engines and screen readers. Always stay within the limits specified by your tire and rim manufacturers.
standards.legendDescription: Recommended combinations are the preferred tire and rim pairings in the chart. Possible combinations are allowed chart pairings outside the preferred range.
standards.captionHookless: DT Swiss hookless TSS recommended and possible tire width to rim inner width combinations
standards.captionHooked: DT Swiss hooked TC recommended and possible tire width to rim inner width combinations
